violation_type.title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))
violation_type.short_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation has not documented any severe weather drills for the year.

finding_variants.text: The operation has not documented any severe weather drills for the year.
The center is not practicing sever weather and lock down drills. These drills must be practiced four times in a calendar year.
During review the daycare had not completed 4 severe weather drills in the past calendar year.
The emergency practices log for last school year 2022-2023 had documentation for only two drills conducted all year.
At the time of inspection, sheltering drills have not been conducted and there is no documentation availavle for review of the last drill conducted.
At the time of inspection, safety drills have  not been completed as required by standards.
